steps.en: Review and install the skill; approve CLI setup and browser authorization
steps.zh: 审查安装技能，批准 CLI 安装并完成浏览器授权

steps.en: Provide a local report and request an upload
steps.zh: 提供本地报告，明确要求上传

steps.en: Check intent, application-folder destination and any overwrite confirmation
steps.zh: 检查意图、应用目录目标与覆盖确认

steps.en: Invoke the external bdpan CLI to upload the file
steps.zh: 调用外部 bdpan CLI 上传文件

steps.en: Present the actual saved path and service-returned viewing link
steps.zh: 展示实际保存路径与服务返回的查看链接

value.en: Deliver the report from the agent conversation without manually copying a cloud link
value.zh: 在 agent 对话中交付报告，不再手动复制网盘链接
